_comment: Lines for who you were before the fall (flag origin_<id>) and for a run that remembers an earlier ending (flag echo, echo_<ending>).

lines.text: A medic! Ha! Don't look at me like that. I've been coughing for eleven years. It's a hobby. I'm very good at it.
You look at me like you already know how this ends. Ha! Don't tell me. I hate knowing the end.
